1.1Company Overview

A design engineering house with shop-floor manufacturing depth

THREE STAR ENTERPRISES is a Pune-based design and manufacturing company that provides comprehensive design, full turnkey manufacturing, and product management services to global Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). Catering to the material handling, automation, pharmaceutical, food, and process industries, the company specializes in the New Product Introduction (NPI) process to efficiently identify and resolve challenges related to design optimization, procurement, and manufacturing setups.

We work alongside OEM engineering teams on equipment programmes — reviewing intent, developing the 3D design, procuring verified components, and manufacturing the custom machine. Because design and fabrication sit in the same Pune facility, drawings are validated by the people who assemble and trial the equipment.

Pillar 01

Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

Every CAD model is optimized for machining setups, raw material standard sizes, and fast maintenance.

Pillar 02

Turnkey Single-Point

Single-source responsibility covering mechanical, electrical controls, PLC programming, and commissioning.

1.5NPI Engineering

New Product Introduction (NPI) Step-by-Step

Our NPI process systematically eliminates risk before production begins — verifying part fitment, tool access, cycle times, and quench parameters.

  1. 01Step

    Concept

    Requirement study, application context and functional intent captured with the OEM engineering team.

    MILESTONE 01
  2. 02Step

    Design

    Detailed mechanical design, assembly modelling and manufacturing drawings prepared for the build.

    MILESTONE 02
  3. 03Step

    Optimization

    Design reviewed for manufacturability, standardisation, cycle time and cost of the finished equipment.

    MILESTONE 03
  4. 04Step

    Procurement

    Bought-out selection, vendor development and sourcing of fabricated and machined content.

    MILESTONE 04
  5. 05Step

    Prototype / Manufacturing

    Fabrication, machining and assembly of the first build with in-process engineering support.

    MILESTONE 05
  6. 06Step

    Process Fine Tuning

    Setup trials, parameter refinement and correction of process and handling challenges.

    MILESTONE 06
  7. 07Step

    Final Manufacturing

    Stabilised build documentation handed over for repeat manufacturing and support.

    MILESTONE 07
